test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: 9 boys and 12 men can complete a work in 24 days. Each boy takes thrice the time taken by a man to complete the work. In how many days will 15 men complete the same work?
solution:
Given:

9B + 12M = 24 days

B = 3M

Formula used:

Time = 1/Efficiency

Solution:

Let, m = total work done

Work done by 9 boys = 9/3m

Work done by 12 men = 12/m 

⇒ 9/3m + 12/m = 1/24

(3 + 12) x 24 = m

m = 15 x 24 days = 360

The number of days required by 15 men to complete the work = (360)/15 = 24 days.

The answer is 24 days.
